    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                yield _sse(
                    "message_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "message_delta",
                        "delta": {
                            "stop_reason": _FINISH_REASON_MAP.get(finish_reason, "end_turn"),
                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"

async def _handle_streaming(openai_req: dict, model: str):
    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                yield _sse(
                    "message_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "message_delta",
                        "delta": {
                            "stop_reason": _FINISH_REASON_MAP.get(finish_reason, "end_turn"),
                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"

async def _handle_streaming(openai_req: dict, model: str):
    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                yield _sse(
                    "message_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "message_delta",
                        "delta": {
                            "stop_reason": _FINISH_REASON_MAP.get(finish_reason, "end_turn"),
                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"
```

    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                        "type": "message_delta",
                        "delta": {

                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"

async def _handle_streaming(openai_req: dict, model: str):
    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                yield _sse(
                    "message_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "message_delta",
                        "delta": {
                            "stop_reason": _FINISH_REASON_MAP.get(finish_reason, "end_turn"),
                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"

async def _handle_streaming(openai_req: dict, model: str):
    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                yield _sse(
                    "message_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "message_delta",
                        "delta": {
                            "stop_reason": _FINISH_REASON_MAP.get(finish_reason, "end_turn"),
                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"
```

            if usage:

                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {

                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },

            for tc in tool_calls:

async def _handle_streaming(openai_req: dict, model: str):
    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                yield _sse(
                    "message_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "message_delta",
                        "delta": {
                            "stop_reason": _FINISH_REASON_MAP.get(finish_reason, "end_turn"),
                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"

async def _handle_streaming(openai_req: dict, model: str):
    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                yield _sse(
                    "message_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "message_delta",
                        "delta": {
                            "stop_reason": _FINISH_REASON_MAP.get(finish_reason, "end_turn"),
                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"

async def _handle_streaming(openai_req: dict, model: str):
    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                yield _sse(
                    "message_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "message_delta",
                        "delta": {
                            "stop_reason": _FINISH_REASON_MAP.get(finish_reason, "end_turn"),
                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"

async def _handle_streaming(openai_req: dict, model: str):
    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                yield _sse(
                    "message_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "message_delta",
                        "delta": {
                            "stop_reason": _FINISH_REASON_MAP.get(finish_reason, "end_turn"),
                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"

```python
async def _handle_streaming(openai_req: dict, model: str):
    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                yield _sse(
                    "message_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "message_delta",
                        "delta": {
                            "stop_reason": _FINISH_REASON_MAP.get(finish_reason, "end_turn"),
                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"
```

async def _handle_streaming(openai_req: dict, model: str):
    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                    "message_delta",

                        "delta": {

                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"

async def _handle_streaming(openai_req: dict, model: str):
    """Handle a streaming request by translating OpenAI SSE chunks to Anthropic format."""
    openai_req["stream"] = True
    openai_req["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
    response_stream = await litellm.acompletion(**openai_req)

    async def generate():
        msg_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]}"
        content_block_idx = 0
        active_tool_calls: dict[int, dict] = {}
        has_emitted_text_block = False
        input_tokens = 0
        output_tokens = 0

        # message_start
        yield _sse(
            "message_start",
            {
                "type": "message_start",
                "message": {
                    "id": msg_id,
                    "type": "message",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "model": model,
                    "content": [],
                    "stop_reason": None,
                    "stop_sequence": None,
                    "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0},
                },
            },
        )

        async for chunk in response_stream:
            data = chunk.model_dump()
            choices = data.get("choices", [])

            usage = data.get("usage")
            if usage:
                input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)

            if not choices:
                continue

            delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
            finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason")

            # Text content
            text = delta.get("content")
            if text:
                if not has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
                        },
                    )
                    has_emitted_text_block = True

                yield _sse(
                    "content_block_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "content_block_delta",
                        "index": content_block_idx,
                        "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": text},
                    },
                )

            # Tool calls
            tool_calls = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
            for tc in tool_calls:
                tc_idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                if tc_idx not in active_tool_calls:
                    if has_emitted_text_block:
                        yield _sse(
                            "content_block_stop",
                            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                        )
                        content_block_idx += 1
                        has_emitted_text_block = False

                    tool_id = tc.get("id", f"tool_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}")
                    func = tc.get("function", {})
                    tool_name = func.get("name", "")
                    active_tool_calls[tc_idx] = {
                        "id": tool_id,
                        "name": tool_name,
                        "block_idx": content_block_idx,
                    }

                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_start",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_start",
                            "index": content_block_idx,
                            "content_block": {
                                "type": "tool_use",
                                "id": tool_id,
                                "name": tool_name,
                                "input": {},
                            },
                        },
                    )

                func = tc.get("function", {})
                args_chunk = func.get("arguments", "")
                if args_chunk:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_delta",
                        {
                            "type": "content_block_delta",
                            "index": active_tool_calls[tc_idx]["block_idx"],
                            "delta": {
                                "type": "input_json_delta",
                                "partial_json": args_chunk,
                            },
                        },
                    )

            # Finish
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if has_emitted_text_block:
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": content_block_idx},
                    )
                for tc_info in active_tool_calls.values():
                    yield _sse(
                        "content_block_stop",
                        {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": tc_info["block_idx"]},
                    )

                yield _sse(
                    "message_delta",
                    {
                        "type": "message_delta",
                        "delta": {
                            "stop_reason": _FINISH_REASON_MAP.get(finish_reason, "end_turn"),
                            "stop_sequence": None,
                        },
                        "usage": {"output_tokens": output_tokens},
                    },
                )

                yield _sse("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})

    return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")


def _sse(event_type: str, data: dict) -> str:
    """Format a Server-Sent Event."""
    return f"event: {event_type}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"
